content_sections.heading: Telangana Housing Board Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The Telangana Housing Board is recruiting Assistant Engineers (Civil) for work associated with the Indiramma Indlu Affordable Urban Housing Programme in Hyderabad. The engagement is purely on an outsourcing basis and does not provide any right to regular appointment in TGHB. Register for Job Alerts

rows.details: Merit in Qualifying Examination and Interview

content_sections.heading: Telangana Housing Board Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: The online application process for Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026 is open from 8 October to 21 October 2026. Candidates must complete the application form by 5:00 PM on the closing date.

content_sections.heading: Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The Telangana Housing Board has announced 25 vacancies for Assistant Engineer (Civil) positions. The recruitment is for the Indiramma Indlu Affordable Urban Housing Programme in the CURE Area of Hyderabad.

content_sections.heading: Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer posts must meet the educational qualification and experience requirements specified in the notification. Applicants must possess a B.E. or B.Tech degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Board. Candidates must have a minimum of 2 years of experience in multistoried residential or infrastructure works. Preference will be given to candidates with knowledge and experience in the following areas: High-rise building projects Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) works Quality Control (QC) Quantity Surveying AutoCAD Preparation of estimates Important: The two-year experience requirement is mandatory. The listed technical skills and project experience are preference criteria mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The minimum age required for Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026 is 18 years, while the maximum age is 44 years.

content_sections.heading: Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for the Assistant Engineer (Civil) position will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 33,800 . The appointment is on an outsourcing basis for one year. The notification states that this engagement does not confer any right to regular appointment in the Telangana Housing Board.

content_sections.heading: Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection for Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026 will be based on merit in the qualifying examination, followed by an interview. Qualifying Examination Merit: Candidates will be considered based on their merit in the prescribed educational qualification. Interview: An interview will be conducted by the Office of the Chief Engineer, TGHB, jointly with the outsourcing agency.

content_sections.heading: Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer Job Location
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be posted in the CURE Area (within ORR), Hyderabad , under the Indiramma Indlu Affordable Urban Housing Programme. The specific posting will be allocated by the Chief Engineer or Deputy Chief Engineer of the Telangana Housing Board.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Telangana Housing Board Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their applications through the official Google Form provided in the recruitment notification. The last date for submission is 21 October 2026 at 5:00 PM. Visit the official Telangana Housing Board website at tghb.telangana.gov.in . Read the Assistant Engineer (Civil) outsourcing recruitment notification. Open the official online application Google Form. Enter the requested details accurately. Provide the educational qualification and experience information requested in the form. Review the completed form and submit it before the deadline. Application Deadline: 21 October 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in Telangana Housing Board Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Telangana Housing Board has announced 25 Assistant Engineer (Civil) vacancies on an outsourcing basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 21 October 2026, up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a B.E. or B.Tech degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Board.

faq.question: Q4. Is work experience mandatory for Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants must have at least two years of experience in multistoried residential or infrastructure works.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 44 years as on 1 July 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 33,800.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on merit in the qualifying examination, followed by an interview conducted by the Office of the Chief Engineer, TGHB, jointly with the agency.

faq.question: Q8. Can freshers apply for Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. The notification requires a minimum of two years of relevant experience in multistoried residential or infrastructure works.

faq.question: Q9. Is Telangana Housing Board Assistant Engineer Recruitment 2026 a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on an outsourcing basis for one year and does not provide any right to regular appointment in TGHB.
